summaryZh: Mental Health in Design Lab 关注技术设计和交互中的心理健康与情绪福祉。页面涉及人工智能、移动应用、社交媒体与在线社区，并强调理解用户心理、情绪和社会需求。

evidence.quote: MiD lab M ental Health in Design Lab

If we want to improve the lives and health of people, we need to consider mental health at the forefront of all technology design and interaction. Artificial Intelligence & GenAI Algorithms​ Mobile Apps & Devices Social Media ​ Online Communities Understanding psychological, emotional, & social needs
